name: Sparked and Ready! gained during a Rocket Launcher cast waits for the next Rocket Launcher
contract: Sparked and Ready! (537247) makes the next Rocket Launcher instant and adds 20% damage. A Rocket Launcher already being cast when the buff arrives started without it and took its full cast time, so finishing that cast must leave the buff in place; the following Rocket Launcher is then instant and consumes it.

steps.label: Rocket Launcher starts with its cast time
Sparked and Ready arrives while Rocket Launcher is still casting
The cast that started without the buff completes
The completed cast leaves Sparked and Ready for the next Rocket Launcher
The next Rocket Launcher is instant
The instant Rocket Launcher consumes Sparked and Ready
